cards.english_title: Britannia’s “100% Wheat” Claim Meets a 62% Reality
cards.korean_desc: CCPA는 2026년 10월 22일 브리타니아에 벌금을 부과했다 규제기관은 소비자가 빵 전체를 밀로 생각할 수 있다고 했다 광고는 100% 통밀이라 했지만 밀 함량은 62%였다 브리타니아는 광고를 멈추고 15일 안에 보고해야 한다
cards.english_desc: The CCPA fined Britannia ₹1 lakh on October 22, 2026, over its bread advertising. The regulator said the claim could make consumers think the entire loaf was wheat. The advertisement called the product 100% whole wheat, but wheat content was 62%. Britannia must stop the advertisements and report compliance within 15 days.
